deadlines.title: AP EAPCET 2026 Examination
deadlines.description: The Andhra Pradesh Engineering, Agriculture, and Pharmacy Common Entrance Test (AP EAPCET) is a 3-hour, computer-based exam held annually (typically in May) for admission into undergraduate engineering, agriculture, and pharmacy courses. Conducted by JNTUK for APSCHE, it features 160 multiple-choice questions with no negative marking.

CUET UG 2026 Examination
deadlines.description: The Common University Entrance Test (CUET) is a national-level entrance exam conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission to undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate (PG) programs at all central universities and various participating state, deemed, and private universities in India. It provides a single-window opportunity for students to apply to multiple central universities with one exam, focusing on 12th-grade NCERT-based knowledge to offer equal opportunities.

deadlines.title: KCET 2026 Examination
deadlines.description: The Karnataka Common Entrance Test (KCET), commonly known as UGCET, is a state-level entrance exam for admission to undergraduate courses in engineering, pharmacy, agriculture, and other professional fields in Karnataka. Conducted by the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA), it is a pen-and-paper, multiple-choice question exam held in April/May for government and private colleges.

deadlines.title: KEAM 2026 Examination
deadlines.description: KEAM (Kerala Engineering Architecture Medical) is an annual entrance exam conducted by the CEE Kerala for admission to professional degree courses (Engineering, Pharmacy, Architecture, etc.) in Kerala. For 2026, the exam is a 100% computer-based test, with Engineering/Pharmacy held by CEE, while Architecture and Medical admissions use NATA/NEET scores, respectively, alongside mandatory KEAM registration.

deadlines.title: MAH MHTCET 2026 Attempt 1 Examination
deadlines.description: The MHT-CET (Maharashtra Common Entrance Test) is a state-level entrance examination conducted in online (computer-based) mode. The exam pattern is based on the Maharashtra State Board syllabus, with questions from Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics/Biology, and it is multiple-choice (MCQ) in nature with no negative marking. MHT-CET provides admission mainly to government, government-aided, and private colleges in Maharashtra, offering undergraduate programs in Engineering, Technology, and Pharmacy.

deadlines.title: MET 2026 Phase 1 Examination
deadlines.description: The MET (Manipal Entrance Test) is an online computer-based examination conducted by Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE). MET is used for admission to undergraduate engineering and other professional programs offered at MAHEâs constituent campuses, including Manipal, Bengaluru, and other affiliated institutions, which are primarily private deemed-to-be-university colleges.

deadlines.title: NEST (NISER ) 2026
deadlines.description:
The National Entrance Screening Test (NEST) is a compulsory online computer-based test for admission to the five-year Integrated MSc programme offered by the National Institute of Science Education and Research (NISER) and the University of Mumbai - Department of Atomic Energy Centre for Excellence in Basic Sciences (UM-DAE CEBS). NISER and UM-DAE CEBS are autonomous institutions established by the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE), Government of India, in 2007. These institutes were started with the mandate of providing research-oriented teaching in basic sciences by faculties of practising scientists aimed at creating a national pool of human resources to lead the nation to excellence in teaching and research in basic and applied sciences.
NEST 2026 will be conducted in around 140 cities across India.

events.eventFullDescription: A long running tradition at Sri Balaji University, the Aiyaswamy Cultural Competition, is held every year at the end of the induction period in the spacious Ranganathan Auditorium. The Aiyaswamy Cultural Competition was first introduced in the year 2015 before which it was known as the fresher’s party. Except for the name, nothing much has changed. It was conducted, and participated in with same energy, zeal, fervor, and enthusiasm. In fact, the craze and anticipation for the fest amongst the student managers has only increased since then. Apart from the 2 days of break from regular classes what adds enthusiasm to the students is the prize money and a trip to Goa. The winning group is awarded a cash prize of INR 1, 50,000/- and a trip to Goa. This year, River Ganga won the Aiyaswamy Cup and the trip to Goa.

Drishti is an annual, pan-society event involving all the four institutes of Sri Balaji University .Drishti offers something for everyone. For the budding business barons, there is an opportunity to participate in business quiz, or draw out a business plan. For the culturally inclined, the event offers an occasion to participate in musical contests or showcase their creativity in designing costumes for the fashion show. The athletic ones can partake in the sports event which are conducted on the college grounds or at the indoor sports area

infrastructure.infraDescription:
BIMM, as part of the Sri Balaji University, is situated on a 16.5-acre campus in Pune. The infrastructure is designed to provide a comprehensive learning and living experience.

  • Academic Infrastructure 🏫

    • Classrooms: All classrooms are air-conditioned and equipped with modern audio-visual aids, including LCD projectors and public address systems, to facilitate an interactive learning environment.

    • Auditoriums: The campus houses multiple auditoriums and seminar halls, with the largest having a seating capacity of over 1000 people. These are used for guest lectures, national seminars, and student events.

    • Library: The central library has an extensive collection of over 1,50,000 books, journals, and e-resources. It subscribes to a vast number of national and international journals, magazines, and online databases like EBSCO, ensuring students have access to the latest research and business information.

    • Computer Labs: Multiple state-of-the-art computer labs are available 24/7 with high-speed internet connectivity. They are equipped with the latest software for data analytics, programming, and business simulations.

  • Hostel & Residential Facilities 🏨

    • Accommodation: The institute provides separate and secure hostel accommodation for male and female students on campus. The rooms are well-furnished.

    • Mess & Cafeteria: A large, multi-cuisine dining hall serves hygienic and nutritious meals. The campus also has a cafeteria that serves snacks and beverages throughout the day.

    • Connectivity: The entire campus, including the hostels, is Wi-Fi enabled.

  • Sports & Recreation 🏊‍♂️

    • Health & Fitness: A modern swimming pool and a well-equipped gymnasium are available for students to maintain their physical fitness.

    • Outdoor & Indoor Sports: The campus has facilities for various sports, including basketball courts, volleyball courts, and grounds for football and cricket. There are also provisions for indoor games like table tennis, carrom, and chess.

  • Other Amenities ☕

    • Medical Facilities: A healthcare center with a resident doctor and ambulance facility is available on campus to handle medical emergencies.

    • Convenience Store: A tuck shop on campus caters to the daily needs of the students.
